description: This file contains helper functions for managing relationships between modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving relationship properties, querying relationships, and linked record management.

methods.name: check_for_relationship
methods.description: Checks if a relationship exists for a given module in a list of relationships and returns the table name if found.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships_properties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a relationship between two modules, optionally filtered by relationship name.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves all viewable relationships between two modules, returning result set and total count.

methods.name: retrieve_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves modified relationships between two modules, with options for specific fields and relationship name.

methods.name: server_save_relationships
methods.description: Saves a list of relationship records, handling insert, update, and date modifications.

methods.name: get_from_statement
methods.description: Extracts the FROM clause from a SQL query, excluding ORDER BY.

methods.name: retrieve_relationship_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve relationship data between two modules.

methods.name: get_module_link_field
methods.description: Returns the link field name between two modules if exists.

methods.name: get_linked_records
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of records linked to a given record in another module.
